events.title: Mongols rout the Rus and Cumans at the Kalka River
events.description: A Mongol expedition under Jebe and Subutai crushed the armies of several Rus princes and their Cuman allies. The full Mongol conquest of the Rus lands came fourteen years later.
events.html: A Mongol expedition under Jebe and Subutai crushed the armies of several Rus princes and their Cuman allies. The full Mongol conquest of the Rus lands came fourteen years later.

events.title: Raden Wijaya's forces defeat the Mongol expedition to Java
events.description: Majapahit forces under Raden Wijaya, who had used the Mongol expedition sent by Kublai Khan against his rival, turned on the invaders and won a major victory. The day was later taken as the founding date of the city of Surabaya.
events.html: Majapahit forces under Raden Wijaya, who had used the Mongol expedition sent by Kublai Khan against his rival, turned on the invaders and won a major victory. The day was later taken as the founding date of the city of Surabaya.

events.title: Martin Frobisher sails on his third Arctic voyage
events.description: Frobisher left Harwich with fifteen ships to mine what he believed was gold ore on Baffin Island. The ore proved worthless, and the Northwest Passage stayed unfound.
events.html: Frobisher left Harwich with fifteen ships to mine what he believed was gold ore on Baffin Island. The ore proved worthless, and the Northwest Passage stayed unfound.

events.title: George Washington signs the first US copyright law
events.description: The Copyright Act protected books, maps and charts for 14 years, renewable once. It drew on Britain's Statute of Anne and founded American copyright law.
events.html: The Copyright Act protected books, maps and charts for 14 years, renewable once. It drew on Britain's Statute of Anne and founded American copyright law.

events.title: The Great Clock of Westminster starts keeping time
events.description: The clock in the new tower of the Houses of Parliament began running. Its great bell, Big Ben, struck the hours for the first time that July.
events.html: The clock in the new tower of the Houses of Parliament began running. Its great bell, Big Ben, struck the hours for the first time that July.

events.title: Treaty of Vereeniging ends the South African War
events.description: Boer leaders accepted British sovereignty over the Transvaal and Orange Free State in return for promises of self-government. The war had cost tens of thousands of lives, many in British camps.
events.html: Boer leaders accepted British sovereignty over the Transvaal and Orange Free State in return for promises of self-government. The war had cost tens of thousands of lives, many in British camps.

events.title: British and German fleets clash at Jutland
events.description: The largest naval battle of the First World War saw the Royal Navy lose more ships and men, but the German High Seas Fleet withdrew to port and rarely ventured out again.
events.html: The largest naval battle of the First World War saw the Royal Navy lose more ships and men, but the German High Seas Fleet withdrew to port and rarely ventured out again.

events.title: Earthquake and avalanche devastate northern Peru
events.description: A magnitude 7.9 earthquake set off an avalanche from Huascarán that buried the town of Yungay. About 70,000 people died, making it Peru's worst natural disaster.
events.html: A magnitude 7.9 earthquake set off an avalanche from Huascarán that buried the town of Yungay. About 70,000 people died, making it Peru's worst natural disaster.
